summary.description: Generate and verify camera-rental device QR label packages from CSV or TSV manifests containing pre-signed payloads. Use when exporting P4P, P3, or other rental-device labels in the Changsha Jiezu Da layout with shop name, phone, device label, right-side QR, 20x40 mm PNGs, A4 PDF, preview, manifest, and ZIP. Excludes QR protocol changes, signing-secret handling, database mutation, shipping, and generic QR design.
summary.selection_rule: Pick the three smallest next steps that increase reliability more than they increase context cost.
